highclere-castle--edwardian.description: Made by Foundation Cigar Co. with the Highclere Castle Cigar Company and released in 2017, the Edwardian is rolled at A.J. Fernandez in Estelí from a Connecticut Shade wrapper, a Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Nicaraguan Criollo and Corojo from Jalapa and Ometepe. It is creamy and bright, with citrus, cinnamon and soft pepper; a gentle choice for the daytime.

thirds.notes: Cream and soft white pepper with cinnamon, a lemon-like brightness and a few nutty, coffee-tinged puffs.
Smoother and more knitted together: cream and citrus lead, with honey, a light coffee note and gentle spice.
Dense cream with milk chocolate and nut notes, the citrus still lively and pepper returning near the end.

highclere-castle--victorian.description: The second Highclere Castle blend from Foundation Cigar Co. wraps a Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Nicaraguan filler in an Ecuadorian Habano leaf. Darker than the Edwardian, it keeps a smooth, creamy retrohale while adding pepper, leather and roasted nuts, with cocoa and coffee arriving mid-smoke; a natural match for a strong cup of coffee.

thirds.notes: Roasted nuts and cedar with black pepper on the retrohale and touches of leather and a light saltiness.
The saltiness fades; hazelnut, cocoa and a dense coffee note come through over leather and a creamy edge.
Pepper stays in charge with hazelnut, leather and wood; some smokes deepen toward earth and caramel.
